name: RevioStar Product Watcher for WooCommerce
author: Keyur

sections.description:
RevioStar Product Watcher for WooCommerce is a WordPress plugin that enhances the WooCommerce product management interface by adding a review rating column to the product listing page in the admin dashboard.

Feature List:

  • Adds a review rating column to the WooCommerce product listing page
  • Displays product ratings directly in the WordPress admin dashboard
  • Supports visual representation using icons and numeric values
  • Includes color-coded indicators for rating visibility
  • Enables direct navigation to the product review section via clickable ratings
  • Works within the default WooCommerce product table interface
  • Uses existing WooCommerce product review data
  • Does not affect the front-end store layout or design
  • Designed for centralized monitoring of product ratings in the admin panel

The plugin displays product ratings directly within the product table, allowing administrators to view review scores without opening individual product pages. Ratings can be presented using visual icons, numeric values, and color-coded indicators for quick identification.

It includes clickable rating elements that provide direct access to the product’s review section, enabling faster navigation to customer feedback and review management screens.

The plugin integrates with existing WooCommerce product data and works within the default WordPress admin panel without modifying the front-end store display.

This tool is intended for store administrators who manage product catalogs and need a structured way to monitor review ratings from a centralized location within the dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to WooCommerce → RevioStar Product Watcher
sections.faq:
What does RevioStar Product Watcher for WooCommerce do?

It adds a review rating column to the WooCommerce product listing page in the WordPress admin dashboard, allowing administrators to view product ratings directly.

Where are the product ratings displayed?

The product ratings are displayed within the WooCommerce product table in the WordPress admin dashboard.

How are the ratings visually represented?

Ratings are displayed using visual icons, numeric values, and color-coded indicators for easier identification.

Can I access product reviews directly from the rating column?

Yes, the rating elements are clickable and provide direct access to the product’s review section.

Does the plugin modify the front-end store design?

No, the plugin works only within the WordPress admin panel and does not affect the front-end store layout or design.

Does the plugin use existing WooCommerce review data?

Yes, it uses existing WooCommerce product review data to display ratings in the admin interface.

Who is this plugin intended for?

This plugin is intended for store administrators who manage product catalogs and need a centralized way to monitor product ratings.
